{{Quote|There's a company called Bantha Moving and Storage. Ever heard of em?''"<br />"''Um...no.''"<br />"''They're new to the smuggling game. They're using that Tusken village to hide their activities, keeping their computers there and sneaking around when the Tuskens are busy.|[[Radeld Siwar]] and a smuggler|<ref name="SWG:BMaS">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Smuggler|Bantha Moving and Storage|Tatooine}}</ref>}}
'''Bantha Moving and Storage''' was a front company for a [[Spice/Legends|spice]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] organization on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] at the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:BMaS" />

==History==
[[File:Junktown.jpg|200px|thumb|The Tusken junk town.]]
{{Quote|Head on over to the Tusken Junktown. See what you can find. They might be there. Not sure. Keep your eyes open.|Radeld Siwar, to a smuggler|<ref name="SWG:BMaS" />}}
They used the [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken]]-infested [[Junktown]] near [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] to hide their activities.<ref name="SWG:BMaS" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] smuggler [[Radeld Siwar]] sent an aspiring smuggler to the Junktown as an introduction to the smuggling business. The smuggler located a storage compartment full of spice samples as well as the computer where the company stored all their spice recipes and stole the samples and recipes for Siwar.<ref name="SWG:BMaS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Bantha Moving and Storage was first mentioned in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:BMaS" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Bantha Moving and Storage was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]]" with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]", a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
